And I am having issue with this one as well.
https://feedback.vrchat.com/sdk-bug-reports/p/custom-components-are-not-allowed-on-editoronly-tagged-gameobjects

You need to tag all the child objects in your "Siro_Wing" prefab as EditorOnly.
It sadly doesn't work with only the root or parent object.
